sections.heading: Ramadan Calendar Drawer Box (Lantern Design) FAQ
sections.text: Questions Ramadan Calendar Drawer Box (Lantern Design) FAQ How many drawers does it have? Usually 30, one for each day of Ramadan. Drawer count and size are confirmed after we review your structure and contents. How is this different from the arch design? This version is a straight rectangular cabinet with a decorative foil band, which packs and ships efficiently; the arch design shapes the top of the cabinet itself. Can the drawers hold dates? Yes. Drawers can carry wrapped dates, chocolates or sweets; food-contact requirements are reviewed on the quote. When should we order for Ramadan? Start early enough to approve the structure and a physical sample before bulk production, plus freight time. We confirm the schedule on the quote.
